employment.title: Senior Director
employment.mandate_line: Mandate: Enterprise AI Practice & Delivery | Scale: 106-Engineer Footprint (66 Analytics, 40 Digital/IT Ops) | Ecosystem: AWS, Azure, Databricks | Tier: Fortune 500
employment.role_narrative: Lead client delivery, practice scaling, and systems architecture for next-generation agentic AI solutions, directing a 106-software-engineer footprint and converting frontier AI research into governed, high-impact production capabilities across enterprise client portfolios.

bullets.text: 106-Engineer Practice and A2A Orchestration: Directed a 106-software-engineer consulting footprint across advanced analytics (66 engineers) and digital operations (40 engineers) for a premier utility while establishing agent-to-agent (A2A) orchestration protocols, deterministic routing fabrics, and policy-bounded tool execution across enterprise accounts.

Production Decision Intelligence and Live Copilot Engine: Architected a 100% local audio airgap (<200ms startup), <250ms Dual-Track Live Executive Copilot, and 18-role / 7-wave strategic decision engine with 20% Bayesian ambiguity gating, 11-gate hybrid BGE-M3 knowledge-graph retrieval, and 0% silent signal loss.
bullets.metric_raw: <200ms audio airgap, <250ms Live Copilot, 18-role / 7-wave decision engine, 20% Bayesian margin, 0% silent signal loss

bullets.text: Zero-Trust Write Custody and Autonomous Delivery: Engineered a 7-layer, 119-package platform with a 5-check Universal Write Gateway, 18 autonomous engineering agents across 32 fail-closed readiness gates, OpenTelemetry forensic lineage, and a six-figure visual asset intelligence platform SOW.
bullets.metric_raw: 7-layer, 119-package platform, 5-check Universal Write Gateway, 18 agents across 32 gates

bullets.text: Enterprise Solution Accelerators: Productized core agentic workflows into reusable client accelerators across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Databricks ecosystems, shortening enterprise adoption timeframes from months to weeks and driving scalable high-margin delivery motions.
bullets.metric_raw: months to weeks enterprise adoption reduction

employment.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
employment.mandate_line: Mandate: $22M IP-Led Platform P&L | Margin: +20% Gross Margin Expansion | Org Scale: Scaled AI Platform Team 3.5x (8 to 28 Specialists) | Tier: Fortune 500 Finance
employment.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

bullets.text: Enterprise Agentic AI Platform Architecture: Designed and operationalized a governed agentic AI platform for regulated enterprise workflows, combining deterministic routing, multi-agent orchestration, GraphRAG retrieval, sandboxed execution, policy gating, validation controls, and replayable execution traces.

Dependency Graph Accelerator: Built and applied software dependency graph intelligence to accelerate the path from legacy system analysis to governed agentic deployment, improving architecture visibility, exposing dependency chains, and reducing refactor risk across complex enterprise environments.

Governed Runtime Reliability: Strengthened enterprise retrieval quality, context assembly, evaluation gates, telemetry instrumentation, rollback controls, and AI CI/CD standards, improving production reliability and making AI behavior more traceable, supportable, and repeatable in live enterprise workflows.

Production Adoption: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle across intake, validation, execution, monitoring, and remediation, reducing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks while preserving deterministic auditability and runtime stability.
bullets.metric_raw: 6 months to 3 weeks cycle time reduction

bullets.text: Distributed Ecosystem Engineering: Architected cloud-native microservices across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse, integrating enterprise data pipelines, vector services, API gateways, identity controls, and highly available execution layers supporting parallel decision workflows.

Platform Commercialization and Engineering Leadership: Productized core agentic AI primitives into reusable platform services, generating $22M in IP-led revenue and shifting the organization from bespoke engagements to scalable platform economics tied to repeatable production adoption; expanded gross margins by 20%; and scaled the ML engineering organization from 8 to 28 specialists, including senior engineers and platform leads.
bullets.metric_raw: $22M IP-led revenue, 20% margin expansion, 8 to 28 specialists

employment.title: Partner
employment.mandate_line: Mandate: $30M Cloud & AI Transformation P&L (+$15M Hyperscaler Co-Sell) | Role: Lead Enterprise Systems Architect & Commercial Partner | Tier: Global Banking
employment.role_narrative: Led architecture and commercial ownership of a $30M cloud and AI transformation portfolio, serving as systems architect for Fortune 500 financial institutions migrating to distributed cloud-native data platforms enabling governed analytics and enterprise AI adoption.

bullets.text: AI and Data Platform Architecture: Architected cloud-native AI and analytics platforms that enabled governed enterprise decision systems operating at 99.9% uptime across regulated financial environments.

Cloud Infrastructure Modernization: Led migration from legacy on-prem environments to scalable cloud-native architectures, reducing infrastructure overhead by 30% and creating the data and compute foundation for faster analytics and ML deployment.

Reusable Platform Design: Converted bespoke regulatory and analytics workflows into reusable SaaS-like platforms, improving renewal rates by 25% through standardized architecture, shared services, and repeatable lifecycle management.

Latency, Lineage, and Observability: Engineered near-real-time ingestion, lineage, and observability frameworks that reduced regulatory response latency by 50% while improving trace integrity and operational transparency across distributed data flows.
Strategic Partnerships: Structured multi-year hyperscaler alliances generating $15M in incremental revenue through co-sell motions aligned to platform modernization and AI growth.

employment.title: Chief Technology Officer
employment.mandate_line: Mandate: Founder-led 0-to-1 GTM and cloud-native modernization for insurers.
employment.capsule_bullet: Directed monolith-to-AWS cloud transformations and SOC 2 control frameworks for regulated insurers, cutting client total cost of ownership by 40% and achieving 99.99% underwriting availability.
employment.role_narrative: Founded and led a cloud-native engineering firm modernizing legacy insurance technology stacks for middle-market insurers, enabling faster delivery, stronger controls, and greater operating agility.

bullets.text: Legacy-to-Cloud Transformation: Led end-to-end modernization of monolithic policy administration systems into AWS-based architectures, reducing total cost of ownership by 40% while retiring long-standing technical debt and improving delivery speed for client-facing insurance platforms.

Governance and Security: Designed SOC 2-aligned cloud control frameworks that enabled regulated insurers to adopt modern analytics and ML capabilities with stronger security, auditability, and operational discipline.

Operational Resilience: Re-architected underwriting and operational systems for high availability, achieving 99.99% uptime and enabling real-time ingestion to support dynamic pricing, faster decisions, and more responsive core insurance workflows.

employment.title: Principal / Actuarial & Quantitative Consultant
employment.mandate_line: Mandate: Global Banking & Insurance Regulatory Analytics, ERM & Capital Advisory.
employment.capsule_bullet: Directed a $15M regulatory analytics transformation that cut audit remediation costs by 40% via automated lineage, and optimized insurer capital reserves by 12% under Solvency II and AG43 using stochastic and multi-Greek hedge models.
employment.earlier_quantitative_foundation: Earlier Quantitative Foundation: Actuarial and quantitative derivatives roles at Towers Perrin, ING, and Aetna (exotic options, multi-Greek hedging, HPC valuation).
employment.role_narrative: Led regulatory analytics, predictive risk modeling, and capital optimization programs at Ernst & Young following early-career quantitative finance and actuarial roles at Towers Perrin, ING, and Aetna.

bullets.text: Regulatory Analytics Modernization: Directed a $15M transformation program that improved lineage, controls, and predictive risk capabilities across audit and regulatory workflows.
Commercial Turnaround: Achieved a 40% reduction in audit remediation costs by implementing automated data lineage and predictive risk modeling across regulatory workflows.
Capital Optimization: Optimized capital reserve requirements under Solvency II and AG43, reducing redundant capital holdings for insurance clients by 12% while maintaining full compliance.

Actuarial & Quantitative Foundation: Priced exotic derivatives and structured multi-Greek hedging strategies, built stochastic capital models, and supported HPC-based valuation frameworks for scenario testing and capital adequacy — quantitative rigor and risk discipline that now underpin my work in AI platform architecture and runtime governance.
